يستأنفوا (form X)
# يَسْتَأْنِفُوا (yastaʔnifū) /jas.taʔ.ni.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَفَ (istaʔnafa)
# يُسْتَأْنَفُوا (yustaʔnafū) /jus.taʔ.na.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَفَ (istaʔnafa)
